cards.title: Sorting into ranges
cards.body: To sort a value into ranges, check one edge at a time. Because the first match wins, each elif needs only one comparison.

hi.title: Ranges mein baantna
hi.body: Kisi value ko ranges mein baantne ke liye ek baar mein ek edge check karo. Pehla match jeet jaata hai, isliye har elif ko sirf ek comparison chahiye.

cards.title: Checking a range in one go
cards.body: Python can chain comparisons: `3 <= age <= 12` is True when age is from 3 to 12, both included.

hi.title: Ek baar mein range check karna
hi.body: Python comparisons ko chain kar sakta hai: `3 <= age <= 12` True hai jab age 3 se 12 tak ho, dono shaamil.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: At exactly 18 o'clock it prints nothing at all. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: `hour > 18` skips 18 itself. Use `else:` to catch everything left, or `hour >= 18`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Theek 18 baje yeh kuch bhi print nahi karta. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: `hour > 18` khud 18 ko chhod deta hai. Baaki sab pakadne ke liye `else:` use karo, ya `hour >= 18`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: 12 < 12 is False, so 12 goes to else. Edges are where < and <= differ, so test them.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: 12 < 12 False hai, isliye 12 else mein jaata hai. Edges par hi < aur <= ka farak padta hai, isliye unhe test karo.

exercise.prompt: Read an age and print the ticket price: `0` for under 3, `5` for ages 3 to 12, `10` for 13 to 64, and `6` for 65 and over.
exercise.promptHi: Ek age padho aur ticket price print karo: 3 se kam ke liye `0`, 3 se 12 ke liye `5`, 13 se 64 ke liye `10`, aur 65 ya usse zyada ke liye `6`.
